title: See, Think, Use: Diagnosing Perception and Reasoning Failures in VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.01467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present See, Think, Use, a protocol that traces each answer of a vision-language model to perception, reasoning or the use of perception. The diagnosis shows a developer which stage to improve and directs test-time compute to the stage that fails. Benchmarks score the final answer, and an answer that rests on the image earns the same credit as a guess or a memorized prior. The protocol asks the model two extra questions per item and needs no access to its weights. A localization probe asks for a box around every instance and measures seeing, and a text-replacement probe answers from a description and measures thinking. Use is the rate at which the answer follows the model's own perception across counterfactual image pairs. The rate needs no answer labels, because the question and its prior are the same on both images. On two model families and six datasets the protocol shows that the knob that helps follows the task family. Answers

translated_title: 看、想、用：诊断视觉语言模型中的感知与推理失败
translated_abstract: 我们提出了“看、想、用”，这是一种能够将视觉语言模型的每个答案追溯到感知、推理或对感知的使用三个阶段的诊断协议。该诊断可以告诉开发者应当改进哪个阶段，并将测试时计算引导到失败的环节。基准测试只对最终答案评分，基于图像得出的答案与猜测或记忆的先验获得同样的分数。该协议在每个题目上只需向模型额外提出两个问题，且无需访问模型权重。定位探针要求模型为每个实例框出边界框，以测量“看”的能力；文本替换探针让模型基于文字描述来回答问题，以测量“想”的能力。“用”衡量的是在反事实图像对上，答案遵循模型自身感知的比率。该比率无需答案标签，因为问题和其先验在两张图像上是相同的。在两个模型家族和六个数据集上，该协议表明有效的改进手段取决于任务类型。
tldr: 该论文提出“看、想、用”协议，通过定位探针、文本替换探针和反事实图像对，在无需访问模型权重的情况下，将视觉语言模型的每个答案归因于感知、推理或感知使用，从而精准定位应改进的环节并指导测试时计算的分配。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "See, Think, Use," a weight-free diagnostic protocol that attributes each VLM answer to perception, reasoning, or use of perception via localization probes, text-replacement probes, and counterfactual image pairs, pinpointing which stage to improve and guiding test-time compute allocation.
